import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_relu_field_b(i_n)
    branch_stack = Vector{Int64}(undef, div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1)
    return branch_stack
end

function relu_field_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n, branch_stack)
    for i_x = 1:i_n
        if u[i_x] > 0.0
            branch_stack[(i_x - 1) + 1] = 1
            v[i_x] = u[i_x] ^ 2
        else
            branch_stack[(i_x - 1) + 1] = 0
            v[i_x] = 0.0
        end
    end
    for i_seq_x = 1:i_n
        loss[1] = loss[1] + v[i_seq_x]
    end
    for i_seq_x = i_n:-1:1
        vb[i_seq_x] = vb[i_seq_x] + lossb[1]
    end
    for i_x = i_n:-1:1
        __branch = branch_stack[(i_x - 1) + 1]
        if __branch == 1
            ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + (2 * u[i_x]) * vb[i_x]
            vb[i_x] = 0.0
        else
            vb[i_x] = 0.0
        end
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_relu_field_b_cuda(i_n)
    branch_stack = CuArray{Int64}(undef, div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1)
    return branch_stack
end

function relu_field_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n, branch_stack)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_1!(branch_stack, i_n, u, v)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_2!(i_n, loss, v)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_3!(i_n, lossb, vb)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_4!(branch_stack, i_n, u, ub, vb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_1!(branch_stack, i_n, u, v)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    if u[i_x] > 0.0
        branch_stack[(i_x - 1) + 1] = 1
        v[i_x] = u[i_x] ^ 2
    else
        branch_stack[(i_x - 1) + 1] = 0
        v[i_x] = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_2!(i_n, loss, v)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += v[i_seq_x]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_3!(i_n, lossb, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    vb[i_seq_x] = vb[i_seq_x] + lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_4!(branch_stack, i_n, u, ub, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __branch = branch_stack[(i_x - 1) + 1]
    if __branch == 1
        ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + (2 * u[i_x]) * vb[i_x]
        vb[i_x] = 0.0
    else
        vb[i_x] = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_n = 4
__base_loss = Float64[-0.42146885099181636, -0.755996003287109, 0.23438933511715596, -0.5064999829283781]
__base_u = Float64[-0.42078084024228835, 0.3904625832399566, 0.13229268497145355, -1.19307980129583]
__base_v = Float64[-0.09012861589968843, 0.0658436043839036, 0.008184780257013451, 0.3011381666368541]
__seed_loss = [Float64[-1.3377951383985611, -0.07156740616331257, -0.046642482798676554, 0.7424129298694373], Float64[-0.30696898884771084, -0.5581235225758512, -0.8968074779766025, -0.5003336336815555]]
__seed_u = [Float64[0.4404643586028414, 0.3942336760612319, 0.12326628436863475, -0.44188140605819876], Float64[-0.7548981355711001, -1.995445048224024, 1.5894341273069093, -0.49812039240800354]]
__seed_v = [Float64[-0.06492547163431112, -0.307985330116449, -1.9960891321764396, -1.1264432939471425], Float64[0.06055060179589359, 0.4300903796394778, 0.09909052186776658, -1.2302023407357865]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:2
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  v_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_v); v_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_v[__trial])
  v_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_v)); v_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_v[__trial]))
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_relu_field_b, Any[i_n])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_relu_field_b_cuda, Any[i_n])
  ret_cpu = relu_field_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, v_val_cpu, v_sh_cpu, i_n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = relu_field_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, v_val_gpu, v_sh_gpu, i_n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ()
  ret_gpu_t = ()
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_sh_cpu, Array(u_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_val_cpu, Array(u_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(v_sh_cpu, Array(v_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(v_val_cpu, Array(v_val_gpu)))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
